In sickle cell disease, a single mutation is found in the beta subunit and the and this form of the protein complex is referred to as Haemoglobin S. 
Haemoglobin S forms an abnormal cell shape (sickles) and polymerises in the absence of oxygen.
Voxelotor binds Haemoglobin S and increases the oxygen affinity of Haemoglobin S which reduces sickling, Voxelotor inhibits HbS polymerisation.
